map.E = E° − (RT/nF)lnQ。25℃ 时 2.303RT/F≈0.05: E = E° − (RT/nF)lnQ. At 25 °C, 2.303RT/F ≈ 0.0592 V. When Q = 1, E = E°.

map.电池电势：由 E°、n、Q 算实际 E，评估输出电压。: Cell potential: derive the actual E from E°, n and Q to assess the output voltage.
map.浓差电池：由两端浓度差算电动势。: Concentration cells: compute the EMF from the concentration difference between the two sides.
map.平衡判定：Q=K 时 E=0，反应达平衡。: Equilibrium check: when Q = K, E = 0 and the reaction has reached equilibrium.
map.输入 E°=−0.76 V、n=2、[Zn²⁺]=0.01 M、T=298K，工: Enter E° = −0.76 V, n = 2, [Zn²⁺] = 0.01 M and T = 298 K, the tool outputs E ≈ −0.82 V and notes that half-reactions containing H⁺ vary with pH.
map.转移电子数，由半反应配平得。: The number of electrons transferred, obtained by balancing the half-reaction.
map.是，273+℃，影响 RT/nF 项。: Yes, 273 + °C; it affects the RT/nF term.
map.含 H⁺/OH⁻ 的半反应，Q 含 [H⁺]，E 随 pH 变。: For half-reactions containing H⁺/OH⁻, Q includes [H⁺], so E changes with pH.
